abilities.effect: Charges in at 2.2 m/s. The first plant it would bite takes one 200-damage crush (kills a normal plant), applied once; it then holds still for the 0.8 s crash clip and drops to 0.7 m/s.
abilities.name: Cyclo Crash
abilities.trigger: First plant inside the 1.5 m frontal cone (CycloZombie.gd); never spent on uneatable ground traps

abilities.effect: 10 damage per ram every 0.5 s (2 hits per 1.0 s loop).
abilities.name: Handlebar Ram
abilities.trigger: Plant inside 1.5 m frontal cone, after the crash (inherited)

abilities.effect: 8 damage per hit every 1.0 s (1 hit per loop).
abilities.name: Siege
abilities.trigger: Within 1.3 m of the dais wall (inherited)

clipAnnotations.attack: 1.0 s loop at native 1.0x speed: 2 rams (lunge + pitch + driver heave); 1 plant bite per 0.5 s beat, 1 house hit per loop.
clipAnnotations.crash: One-shot 0.8 s: nose dive, driver thrown over the bars, hood slams, settles back to the rest pose; the enemy holds still while it plays.
clipAnnotations.die: One-shot 1.9 s: tips onto its side, driver slides off, helmet pops off, wheels coast to a stop, shrinks to nothing; then freed.
clipAnnotations.walk: 1.0 s loop at native 1.0x (at the 2.2 m/s charge): driver pedals (crank, both legs, wheels turn once per loop). Playback scales with speed, so after the crash it plods at about 0.32x.

lore: Races in on three wheels and crushes the first plant in its path.
mechanism: Charger: a Hungry Ghost with 110 HP that races in at 2.2 m/s. The first plant it would bite is crushed for crash_damage (200, enough to kill a normal plant) exactly once, after which it holds still for the crash clip and slows to speed_after_crash (0.7 m/s) and bites normally (10 per 0.5 s). Uneatable ground traps are skipped by the inherited targeting, so they do not spend the charge. Walk playback speed follows ground speed. All march/seek/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Cyclo Zombie
